main:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Reads points and weights, precomputes for every subset the closest selected-point distance in each axis, enumerates all ternary horizontal/vertical/unselected assignments to compute the minimum weighted cost for each number of used axes, and prints the N+1 answers." main]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> N </REF>: int "Number of points."
        <REF> X </REF>: int[20] "X coordinates of the points."
        <REF> Y </REF>: int[20] "Y coordinates of the points."
        <REF> P </REF>: int[20] "Weights associated with each point."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> ans </REF>: long[20] "Minimum total cost for each t from 0 to N, printed one per line."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Allocate arrays Z as long[1<<16][16][2] and ans as long[20]; initialize ans[0] to 1L<<60 with the remaining ans elements zero-initialized, then read integer N from standard input. RESULT N]
            [COMMAND For i from 0 to N-1 inclusive, read three integers into X[i], Y[i], and P[i] via scanf, then set ans[i+1] to 1L<<60 as the infinity sentinel. RESULT X,Y,P,ans]
            [COMMAND For each subset mask i from 0 to (1<<N)-1 inclusive, for each point j from 0 to N-1 inclusive, initialize Z[i][j][0] to abs(X[j]) and Z[i][j][1] to abs(Y[j]); then for each k from 0 to N-1 inclusive, if bit k is set in i, update Z[i][j][0] to min(Z[i][j][0], abs(X[j]-X[k])) and Z[i][j][1] to min(Z[i][j][1], abs(Y[j]-Y[k])). RESULT Z]
            [COMMAND Start the mixed-radix ternary counter a with a[0..N-1] as ternary digits and a[N] as sentinel in the all-zero state; while a[N] is zero, enumerate every ternary state of a[0..N-1]. RESULT a]
            [COMMAND In each while iteration, initialize h=0 and v=0; for i from 0 to N-1 inclusive, if a[i]==1 set bit i in h, and if a[i]==2 set bit i in v. RESULT h,v]
            [COMMAND Compute t as the popcount of h|v; this is the number of points assigned to either the horizontal or vertical axis. RESULT t]
            [COMMAND Initialize sum to 0; for i from 0 to N-1 inclusive, add (long)P[i] * min(Z[h][i][0], Z[v][i][1]) to sum. RESULT sum]
            [COMMAND Update ans[t] to min(ans[t], sum). RESULT ans]
            [COMMAND Increment the ternary counter by setting i=0; while a[i]==2, set a[i]=0 and increment i; then increment a[i] once. RESULT a]
            [COMMAND After the while loop terminates, for i from 0 to N inclusive, print ans[i] as a long followed by a newline. RESULT stdout]
            [COMMAND Return 0 from main. RESULT exit_code]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
